plan.action: Add nullable replacement columns or compatible interfaces; design UUID mapping and new keys before changing identifier types.
plan.preconditions: Confirm PostgreSQL version, backups, ownership, consumers and feasible mapping. Review privileges and lock budget.
plan.recovery: Stop deployment before consumers depend on the new fields; keep old fields available.
plan.verification: Rehearse DDL on a disposable database with representative data. Verify identity/sequence/default semantics.

plan.action: Backfill bounded, resumable batches using reviewed transformation logic and coordinated dual writers.
plan.preconditions: Prove mapping uniqueness, handle concurrent writes and define throttling. Numeric identifiers do not have a general UUID cast.
plan.recovery: Pause batches and preserve old data; restore from tested backup only under an approved recovery procedure.
plan.verification: Check mapping completeness, uniqueness, NULL rates and FK consistency under concurrent traffic.

plan.action: Validate CHECK/FK constraints where NOT VALID is supported. Build concurrent indexes outside transaction blocks when appropriate.
plan.preconditions: Confirm constraint support, partition restrictions, existing violations and resource budget. Concurrent index failure can leave an invalid index.
plan.recovery: Investigate failed validation or invalid indexes; repair/retry through separate authorized tooling.
plan.verification: Check constraint validation and pg_index.indisvalid/indisready, compare old/new results and observe lock waits.

plan.action: Deploy compatible readers/writers and transition dependent FKs, views, functions, API/ORM contracts and downstream jobs.
plan.preconditions: Obtain explicit consumer ownership and deployment-order evidence. Account for UNKNOWN and dynamic SQL paths.
plan.recovery: Revert application reads only while both representations remain consistent; otherwise prefer roll-forward.
plan.verification: Observe application errors and old-field usage through an agreed window. Static graph paths do not prove runtime coverage.

plan.action: Remove legacy objects only after verified transition and a separate destructive-change review.
plan.preconditions: Confirm no remaining consumers, validated keys, tested backups and signed-off CASCADE consequences. Schedule lock acquisition.
plan.recovery: Drops can lose data. Reverse DDL does not restore it; use tested recovery or roll-forward with an operator.
plan.verification: Reinspect schema, compare snapshots and run application integration checks. Do not promise zero downtime.
